_comment: EXP 55 -- THE v3 CONTROL. First run of the v3 runner, on a target whose correctness is a property of its generator rather than of adjudication. Two genuinely distinct defects that a single plausible edit could appear to cure: CT-01 is a REASONING defect with a TRUE conclusion (Nyquist misquoted as f_s > f_max; the real criterion is f_s > 2*f_max, and at the document's own numbers the conclusion happens to hold). CT-02 is an INFERENCE defect with a TRUE premise (df = 400/256 = 1.5625 Hz is right; 'therefore resolves 1 Hz' does not follow). Both verified symbolically with SymPy before the run, not taken on the generator's word. THE ANSWER KEY WAS SPLIT OUT OF THE TARGET ON 2026-08-23 -- section 3 stated the ground truth inside the file the runner reads whole and puts in the panel prompt, which is the exposure class that removed exp48 and exp49 from every headline figure. The key now lives in control_two_distinct_defects_KEY.md and is NEVER staged.
_stall_gamma_note: Stall-path gamma thresholds set above the gamma ceiling (1.0) so the stall detector can never fire via gamma — convergence rests on the two-sided gamma-alt gate. Config-level guard, identical to Exp 42/43.
_max_contested_rounds_note: FIX 4 (declared delta, 2026-07-22): lowered from the code default 5. Five rounds of paid compute to age out a churning residual was both wasteful and, against within-grace churn, ineffective (Exp 43). With FIX 1 in place sub-criticals no longer block, so this threshold now governs only genuinely contested items.
_test_cmd_note: Prose target. No test command; S_k is forced off in code (A2).

_convergence_criteria.description: TWO-SIDED GATE (founder ruling 2026-06-10; hardened_gate_enabled=false). gamma is ACTIVE and LOAD-BEARING. Converged iff ALL of: (1) gamma_critical >= 0.30 on the location-keyed critical series; AND (2) 3 consecutive rounds with zero NEW genuine critical (settled/verifier-filtered, location-keyed); AND (3) no unverified critical candidate pending (A4 fail-safe); AND (4) not contested — where, per FIX 1, un-demonstrated sub-critical findings are a logged NON-GATING residual queue; AND (5) not churning; AND (6) irreducible queue within bound.
_convergence_criteria.pass_condition: gamma_critical >= 0.30 AND 3 consecutive zero-NEW-genuine-critical rounds AND no unverified critical pending AND not contested (FIX-1 semantics) AND not churning AND irreducible queue within bound.
_convergence_criteria.fail_condition: Any model fails to produce parseable output in 2+ consecutive rounds; OR non-convergence (then assume MECHANICAL, diagnose under cy — do not demote gamma).

_directives_live._section_10_note: A4 (12 July 2026): section 10 was established INERT — the flag never reaches RunnerConfig and no compelled-convergence text reaches dispatch. Recorded false here for documentation accuracy; behaviourally identical to Exp 42/43, whose configs carried a stale 'true'.

_pre_registration: FROZEN 2026-08-23 BEFORE THE RUN. Exp 55 is the first run of the v3 runner (ten mechanically-validated patches; see the runner's version banner). PREDICTIONS, each falsifiable: (1) THE DISCRIMINATION CONTROL FIRES AT LEAST ONCE -- it has never fired in this project's life, and T02 now derives a corrected copy from each finding's own proposed fix; a run ending with zero discrimination records means T02 did not take. (2) The panel raises findings against CT-01 and CT-02. CT-01 is the hard one: its conclusion is TRUE, so a checker that verifies conclusions rather than reasoning will miss it. (3) IF both are raised and the pair is adjudicated, counterfactual repair returns DIFFERENT if it is sound and SAME if it is degenerate on prose -- the open question the runway records, with CC2 and DeepSeek on opposite sides. (4) CORROBORATED appears if two models raise the same defect, and source_aliases exceeds 1.00 per finding for the first time in the project's history. (5) The survived-falsification ledger records at least one row, so a clean result is a positive record rather than an absence. FAILURE MODES to report honestly: non-convergence means MECHANICAL, diagnose under cy, do NOT demote gamma; a silent zero on any of (1), (4) or (5) means the corresponding patch did not take and must be reported as such rather than explained away. NO TUNING AFTER RESULTS.
_plan_ref: First v3 run. Purpose: prove the ten patches in situ before the larger shakedown, exp50/51 redesign, the capstone and BR2.
_locationkey_note: Location keying is AST-symbol based and a prose target has no symbols. Off, and the convergence count falls back to the settled series -- declared, not silent.

_ouroboros._note: External literature retrieval OFF. This control tests the INSTRUMENT, and a live retrieval would add an uncontrolled input to a run whose whole value is that its inputs are known.
